historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly treats AC cycling as operator-owned and service-impacting, but its capture neither proves the selected outlet nor meets the source's per-cycle BMC and long-term stability criteria.

historical_reviews.v3_1: The defining oracle is recovery from total AC removal under Always-On policy. Each cycle must bind the PDU outlet to the SUT, prove a clean shutdown before AC-off, measure off-dwell and autonomous boot latency, and compare normalized identities only after all PCIe/storage/BMC discovery has stabilized. Evidence must be immutable per cycle because drift location is the failure signal.

original_test_intent: Stress the dedicated SUT through repeated controlled AC removal/restoration and verify autonomous Always-On boot, stable PCIe/storage inventories, correct BMC FRU/SDR and continued usability.
original_method: Approve and record the exact SUT/BMC/PDU outlet and original power policy, drain workloads, capture complete baseline, perform each clean shutdown, cut only the mapped outlet for at least 30 seconds, restore AC, monitor BMC/console and autonomous boot within the approved approximately 600-second bound, collect immutable complete inventories and management data, stop on first anomaly, and restore the original policy after the bounded long-term run.
manual_activity: The lab power/platform owner approves the dedicated target, outlet, Always-On change, exact cycle count and recovery; an authorized operator or separately approved PDU controller performs every AC transition.
required_inputs: Approved cycle count within 1500 machine minutes
safety_requirements: Never cycle an ambiguous or production outlet
Verify clean shutdown before every AC cut
Change Always-On only with approval and restore original policy
Use a bounded count and stop on first hang/drift/error
Never issue another cycle after incomplete boot or shutdown
Do not expose credentials or disable authentication
Maintain independent PDU and console recovery
agent_execution_scope: Confirm clean shutdown readiness each cycle
Coordinate one approved PDU off/on transaction
Measure off dwell, BMC and host boot phases
Normalize and compare each cycle before authorizing continuation
engineer_actions: Approve outlet, policy, count and downtime
Authorize PDU control mechanism and each continuation policy
Stop and lead console/vendor recovery on hang

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The inventory reads are relevant but use unsafe SSH, omit BMC FRU/SDR and boot state, overwrite one `/tmp` lspci file and do not identify cycle or PDU transition. They cannot satisfy long-term per-cycle comparison or recovery proof.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved PDU/operator control and a cycle-ID collector that records shutdown, outlet off/on timestamps, BMC/console boot phases, complete lspci/lsblk/nvme plus FRU/SDR/SEL and normalized hashes for every bounded cycle.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Always-On, 30-second AC-off, approximately 600-second recovery allowance, long-term intent and 1500-minute machine duration remain; owner must convert `long term` into an exact cycle count.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Represent each cycle as a signed timeline from clean shutdown through AC-off/on and autonomous boot to full inventory/BMC comparison, permitting the next cycle only after all gates pass.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact outlet/policy identity, bounded count, immutable cycle artifacts, BMC lifecycle monitoring, normalized comparison and policy restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A final healthy boot cannot reveal which cycle first drifted or whether BMC/FRU/SDR was wrong transiently; one overwritten file destroys the stress history.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Repeated full AC removal stresses power and storage components and may isolate both host and BMC; recovery can require physical service outside Agent control.

project_override_considerations: Approve exact cycle count for the 1500-minute plan, Cyber Switch API/operator method, Always-On property interface and restoration, clean-shutdown deadline, minimum off dwell, boot-readiness oracle and permissible inventory normalization differences.
expected_evidence: Dedicated SUT/BMC/PDU outlet map, original/Always-On policy and approved count/timing
Workload drain, operator/controller authorization, recovery paths and synchronized timestamps
Complete baseline and immutable per-cycle shutdown/PDU/BMC/console/boot timeline
Per-cycle raw and normalized lspci/lsblk/nvme, BMC FRU/SDR/health and SEL/log artifacts with hashes
No-hang, autonomous boot and workable-state proof
Final health and policy restoration, no-retry/no-overwrite audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently describe long-term AC cycling under Always-On with stable device and BMC inventory. The exact cycle count is missing but is an execution parameter, not a contradictory source target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The AC-cycle objective and sequence are clear. Outlet, count, policy and recovery are concrete prerequisites, so classification is REQUIRES.

review_improvement: Turns an operator power action plus ephemeral inventory dump into a bounded, recoverable per-cycle ledger that covers every source acceptance surface and restores the policy change.
independent_technical_reasoning: An Always-On AC test validates the complete power-restoration chain: PDU, standby power, BMC policy, host boot and device enumeration. Because BMC and host may return at different times, inventory captured too early can look like drift and later conceal a slow device. Per-cycle readiness gates and immutable timestamps distinguish genuine topology loss from normal staged recovery while preventing another AC cut before the platform is fully assessed.
